citation: Social Security Allowance Scheme: Old Age Allowance, Old Age Living Allowance, Disability Allowance (administrative scheme, Social Welfare Department)

source.note: ADMIN-POLICY SOURCE, NOT LAW. This scheme is administrative: it is funded by Legislative Council appropriation and has no principal Ordinance. Its rules and rates are those the department publishes; they can change without legislation. Metadata only: the publisher's terms do not permit the text to be deposited here (see SOURCE-LICENSE.md).
